description: Intercept three armed inbound groups along a declared northern corridor, protect your aircraft and manage six existing AIM-120C7 rounds.
score: All three hostiles destroyed by actual player missiles (core successful-hit evidence), player alive, before 600 seconds. Enemy terrain losses do not award player weapon kills. Death or timeout fails. No resupply or hidden-state input.
freeze_policy: Freeze this spec and its SHA before candidate strategy optimization. Retain every original outcome. Holdouts are evaluated only after choosing a candidate.
